release_slices.slice_name: F&B import and item image upload hotfix
release_slices.name: F&B import and item image upload hotfix
release_slices.plain_english_purpose: Stop F&B CSV imports from failing rows with database operation timeouts and tell users exactly when an item image exceeds the 5 MB limit.
release_slices.purpose: Stabilize F&B item import and Storefront Catalog item image upload without changing payments, checkout totals, POS shift rules, or tenant lifecycle behavior.
release_slices.implementation_summary: Caps row-level CSV import writes to reduce tenant database pool pressure, maps upload-limit errors to client-visible 4xx responses, rejects oversized item images in the UI with an exact 5 MB message, retries image override writes without gallery data when a tenant schema lags, and updates regression contracts.
included_features: Regression tests for import concurrency, upload errors, repository fallback, and current POS contracts
excluded_features: Checkout, fiscal receipt, shift-opening, and tenant lifecycle changes
Production deployment outside the signed controller
release_slices.regression_warning_summary: Large CSV imports may complete more slowly, and image uploads now stop immediately when any selected file exceeds 5 MB.
potentially_affected_existing_behaviors: IMS item image selection and upload feedback
Storefront image metadata persistence on lagging tenant schemas
POS login-label and settings-navigation contract coverage
evidence_covering_regression_risk: Targeted backend import, upload-error, and repository tests
